source_span.text:
Energy-limited toy coil, not a calibrated wet-coil/geometry model.

    leaves at outlet air temperature, so its liquid enthalpy is subtracted.

    condensation, and the energy-balance residual.

target_span.text:

    およびエネルギー収支残差を返します。
